newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kwong Hing set to raise HK$54 mln in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Kwong Hing set to raise HK$54 mln in IPO.

text.p: Hong Kong-based textile manufacturing group Kwong Hing International Holdings Ltd is expected to raise HK$54 million in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong, market sources said on Wednesday.

Sources said Kwong Hing was expected to issue 45 million new shares at HK$1.20 each, representing a prospective price to earnings multiple of 5.59 times on a fully-diluted basis and 4.55 times on a weighted average basis.
The IPO will run from March 7 to 12 and dealing in the company shares is expected to begin on March 19, they said.
Net proceeds of about HK$33 million will be used to buy new machinery, to buy a factory in China and to expand production capacity, sources said.

The company forecast a net profit of HK$42.5 million for the year ending in March 31, 1997, including an exceptional gain of HK$11.3 million from sales of investment property in Hong Kong, one source said.
Standard Chartered Asia is expected to be the sponsor of the issue, they added.
